name: Colin Allred
desc: American politician and former NFL player (born 1983)
summary: Colin Zachary Allred (born April 15, 1983) is an American politician, civil rights lawyer, and former professional football player who is the United States representative-elect from Texas's 33rd congressional district. He previously served as the U.S. representative for Texas's 32nd congressional district from 2019 to 2025. The district included the northeastern corner of Dallas as well as many of its northeastern suburbs.
